title: Sell red house after non-core mortgages exhausted
description: Sell red house after non-core mortgages exhausted. The legal sale is painful but better than bankruptcy to Gamma. The key distinction is whether a non-core mortgage, building sale, or bankruptcy is actually sufficient in this debt state.

final_action.public_message: I need cash, so I'm selling some houses.
final_action.private_thought: I need $310 to pay rent to Gamma. I have $50 cash, shortfall $260. Selling houses yields $50 each. Selling 6 houses gives $300, enough. I'll sell 2 houses from each orange property, preserving at least one house on each for future rent. This maximizes cash while retaining some monopoly strength.
